---
name: Security vulnerability
about: Do not disclose vulnerabilities in a public issue
title: "[Security] "
labels: security
assignees: []
---

Do not include vulnerability details, credentials, private URLs, or exploit steps in a public issue.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting instead:
https://github.com/carlkrott/news-core/security/advisories/new

If private reporting is unavailable, contact the repository owner through GitHub before sharing sensitive details.
